build_TransE_model: build a TransE knowledge base completion model with entity and relation embeddings for link prediction
build_ComplEx_model: build a ComplEx model using complex-valued embeddings for scoring knowledge graph triples
build_TuckER_model: build a TuckER tensor factorization model with a core tensor for knowledge base completion
build_RESCAL_model: build a RESCAL model with relation-specific transformation matrices for scoring knowledge graph triples
build_CP_model: build a CP tensor decomposition model with separate embeddings for head entities, relations, and tail entities
